name: linear_search
summary: Scan for the first element equal to the target; Some(index) on a hit, else None.
vizCode: ({ datatype: 'array', input: [5,3,8,1,9,2,7], run(a) { const target = 9; for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) { a.cursor('i', i); a.mark(i, 'checked'); if (a.get(i) === target) { a.mark(i, 'found'); a.markSorted(); return i; } } } })
